package.name: l5_tracker_lap
package.description: L5 sim-in-loop tracker lap test (roadmap task S.2, claude-docs/12-testing.md): the regression canary for the whole classical stack. Runs racer_gym_bridge and racer_control's tracker_node together against the committed config/tracks/gym_oval raceline and asserts N>=2 laps complete within a committed lap-time band. This package has no library code of its own -- it exists only to host this integration test, which needs both racer_gym_bridge and racer_control built and installed together in the same workspace (see .github/scripts/l5_tracker_lap_test.sh).
